activities.name: Night Market Stall
activities.blurb: Five nights running a dumpling stall: buy supplies, set prices, read the weather forecast and competitors, and buy upgrades. Profit = revenue − costs.
activities.entryBlurb: Run a snack stall for 4 nights! Make enough snacks, pick a good price, and earn a profit.

activities.name: Harbor Trading
activities.blurb: Buy tea, electronics, spices and silk where they're cheap, ship them, and sell where demand is high. Selling a lot drops the price!
activities.entryBlurb: Buy low, sell high! Move cargo between ports to make money.

activities.name: Fixed or Variable Cost?
activities.blurb: Sort business costs into fixed and variable.

activities.name: Ledger Check
activities.blurb: Find the error in each ledger, then build an income statement and check that the balance sheet balances.
activities.entryBlurb: Add up the receipts and find the mistake!

activities.name: Break-Even Lab
activities.blurb: Fixed costs, variable costs and price: how many must you sell to break even? Profit margins and what-ifs.

activities.name: Dim Sum Delivery
activities.blurb: Ride a scooter through Hong Kong delivering orders. Faster = bigger tips. Every meter costs fuel, plan your route!
activities.entryBlurb: Ride the scooter and deliver food fast for tips!

activities.name: My First Stand
activities.blurb: A choose-your-path story about your first lemonade stand.

activities.name: Business Quiz
activities.blurb: Questions about business, trade and economics.

activities.name: Futures Hedging Pit
activities.blurb: Hedge an airline’s fuel bill, a farm’s harvest and a Hang Seng portfolio with futures. Pick the direction and the number of contracts, then survive daily settlement and margin calls.

activities.name: Franchise & M&A Deal
activities.blurb: Work out a franchise’s profit and payback, then value a rival chain with an EBITDA multiple, bridge to equity value and set a disciplined top bid.

activities.name: Supply Chain Desk
activities.blurb: Ship six orders by ocean, rail or air. Balance freight costs against carrying costs and the risk of arriving late. Cheapest freight is not cheapest overall.

activities.name: Choose a Business Structure
activities.blurb: Sole proprietor, partnership, LLC or corporation? Work through personal liability, double taxation, pass-through income, venture funding and self-employment tax.
